question: Can a source word represented by its ordinary lemma and fully retained declared morphological analysis pass necessary fixed-injective-writer frequency conditions?

word: all FEATS keys and values, key-sorted; underscore is explicit unspecified, never inferred
TraditionalMood and TraditionalTense from MISC, independently unspecified if absent
FORM literal only if LEMMA is underscore, to prevent lost unknown lexical content
projection.punctuation: Every integer-ID UPOS=PUNCT token becomes its exact FORM punctuation atom. Attach punctuation to preceding lexical word; leading punctuation to first following word; all-punctuation sentence is one group. No other adjacent words are joined.
projection.order: Every selected integer-ID token appears exactly once, in original order. MWT headers and decimal empty nodes are annotations, not additional running words.
projection.boundaries: Retain sentence boundaries separately, with the future carrier assumed to use explicit layout that does not change lexical group identity. No cost-free extra word/positional aliases are allowed by this fixed common-renderer contract.
projection.unknown: Unspecified features remain unspecified; no inferred gender, case, sense, reference or agreement. Duplicate feature keys, malformed rows, repeated/missing sentence IDs invalidate instead of repair.
projection.omitted: FORM orthography for known lemmas; XPOS, dependency arcs, other MISC fields and exact whitespace. No complete historical meaning, syntax-tree or diplomatic inverse is claimed. Annotation choices/errors remain source assumptions.

carrier_assumption: Every entire projected group maps to one distinct physical word under the same context-independent injective renderer. Different source FORM strings can have the same analysis; one FORM can have several analyses. Neither exact FORM equality nor its old two-alias bound is assumed. Morphological feature and lexicon signs are not yet specified.

screen.native_reader_policy: three alternative readings; no pooled replication

manual_consequence: The same ordinary lemma carries different explicitly attested person or case; these pairs remain distinct. No gloss of a native word. Manual sentences1..4 lie outside all counted books.
predeclared_diagnostics: Full-book lemma/UPOS and complete analysis inventories as learning-cost lower descriptions
Number of source FORM spellings with multiple retained analyses, and analyses with multiple FORM spellings; descriptive only, no followup fit
All full projected sentence roundtrips and fixed sample hashes

decisions.fail: Close this exact projected-source/group/common-renderer conjunction before constructing any carrier. No changed feature subset, punctuation, source, alias or threshold in this work unit.
decisions.pass: Only reconsider a complete paid physical writer; this is neither a full statistical pass nor identification of Latin/native inflection.
decisions.invalid: Report missing source/annotation capacity, not model refutation.

novelty_scope: New projected lexical/grammatical input and one-running-word unit, not 1221 syntactic grouping, a repair of its relation list, or another tiny generated semantic world. Original failures retained.
access: Cached historical source and cached aggregate target summaries only. No native raw text, word assignment, image, relation packet, reserve or f84/f84r/f116v access. All sources exposed. Local construction checkpoint, no push.
